Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints
centered on low back pain and muscle tightness consistent with a lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury described
is plausible for a collision of this type. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted
stretching and strengthening exercises, and graduated activity instruction. Recovery was somewhat slower than
typically expected for a strain of this kind, and the patient remained symptomatic for a longer period than the usual
course would predict. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion were
noted and support the reported injury. Neurological screening, straight leg raise, and reflex testing were within normal
limits. The patient reports no prior inujry or treatment involving the lumbar region. Billing records reflect single charges
for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Continued home exercise and gradual return to normal
activities are recommended, with reassessment if symptoms persist.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
